scenes.label: Meet Tara
scenes.title: Homework at Nani’s
scenes.caption: Meet Tara. After school, she does her homework at Nani's house. Nani makes ginger tea, and they share stories about Nani's village. Today, Nani's phone buzzes. A text message arrives with a six-digit code. Then, straight away, the phone starts ringing. The number is one they don't know.
scenes.dialogue: Nani’s ginger tea makes homework fun!

scenes.label: The first call
scenes.title: “Your card will be blocked!”
scenes.caption: A man says, “I'm a bank officer. Your card will be blocked today! Read me the OTP that just arrived. Quickly!” Nani's face falls. She pays for her medicines with that card. She reaches for her glasses. Tara feels her heart thump. Everything is happening so fast.
scenes.speech: A man says, I'm a bank officer. Your card will be blocked today! Read me the O T P that just arrived. Quickly! Nani's face falls. She pays for her medicines with that card. She reaches for her glasses. Tara feels her heart thump. Everything is happening so fast.

scenes.label: Spot the pattern
scenes.title: Two callers, one trick
scenes.caption: Then a second call beeps in. “Electricity office. Your power will be cut tonight. Tell me the code!” Nani covers the phone. Tara spots the pattern. Both callers rush. Both use an official title. Both want the code. That code is called a one-time password, or OTP.
scenes.speech: Then a second call beeps in. Electricity office. Your power will be cut tonight. Tell me the code! Nani covers the phone. Tara spots the pattern. Both callers rush. Both use an official title. Both want the code. That code is called a one-time password, or O T P.
scenes.dialogue: Both callers want the same secret code!

scenes.label: Your turn
scenes.title: Answer each call safely
scenes.caption: Your turn. Help Tara and Nani answer each pretend call. The callers sound official and very sure. Remember the pattern: a rush, a title, and a request for the code. Choose the safe response for the bank call, then for the electricity call. Think about which number Nani can trust.
scenes.dialogue: Let’s choose the safe answer together.

scenes.label: Why it’s private
scenes.title: A key code stays private
scenes.caption: Nani says no and hangs up on both. An OTP works like a key code. It can unlock one thing, like a payment from Nani's card. Whoever has it can use it. No real bank or office will ever ask for it. If money is lost, an adult should call 1930 quickly.
scenes.speech: Nani says no and hangs up on both. An O T P works like a key code. It can unlock one thing, like a payment from Nani's card. Whoever has it can use it. No real bank or office will ever ask for it. If money is lost, an adult should call nineteen thirty quickly.
scenes.dialogue: The code is a key. It stays with us.

scenes.label: A happier ending
scenes.title: Safe, and still smiling
scenes.caption: Nani calls the number printed on her bank card. Her card is fine! Then she calls the number on her electricity bill. No power cut tonight! The callers were pretending. Nani hugs Tara, and they finish their tea. Your turn: help Tara practise spotting OTP callers and keeping the code private!

scenes.dialogue: We kept the code secret, Nani!
